   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

          Presented by Médi-T



           MEL CUM SALE

         Honey with Salt


Prolapsus uteri and chronic metritis, especially when associated with
        subinvolution and inflammation of the cervix. The special symptom leading to its selection
        is a   feeling of soreness across the hypogastrium from ileum to
        ileum  . Uterine displacements, and in the commencement of metritis Sensation as if
        bladder were too full. Pain from sacrum towards pubes. Pain as if in ureters.



Dose.--  Third to sixth potency. Honey for itching of anus and
        worms.
